anchor_value: raw-source grid shows rendered schedule cost/fair-value columns with dollar signs, but does not expose XBRL unitRef metadata or map row_keys 522133/522135/522194 to filing coordinates
rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 single-cell currency-unit check. I checked the raw source through the evidence CLI: overview/tables identify the schedule-of-investments tables, grid table 11 shows visible Cost and Fair Value cells rendered with dollar signs, and targeted roam queries for CAD, JPY, EUR, U_CAD, U_JPY, U_EUR, and the internal row keys returned no hits. The CLI source view is usable but does not expose the XBRL unit metadata needed to prove whether the non-USD cost_currency values are source facts or extraction artifacts, so the source does not decide the flag.
